Obama urges Democrats to prioritize AI policy

Former U.S. President Barack Obama has privately urged Democrats to make artificial intelligence (AI) oversight a central part of their agenda. He expressed concerns about the potential dangers of AI and called for a clear plan to address the technology. Obama's remarks, reported by The New York Times, suggest a desire for Democrats to move AI policy discussions to the forefront of their political strategy.
